title: Optical force on a slab in front of a mirror: sign change with the gap (analytic)
description:
The radiation_force_slab set-up (em_fdfd_ez at 1550 nm, a y-periodic line source, a lossless 260 nm glass slab n = 1.5 held by a Fixed (domain) support on itself, em_solid_optical_force) with a perfect metal wall (bc_x_hi = pec, E_z = 0 at the centre of the outermost cell) a gap g behind the slab: everything is reflected (|r| = 1) and the slab sits in the standing wave of a lossless cavity. Stationary study swept over g (105..855 nm, more than half a wavelength; the base 705 nm runs last).
Analytic (transfer matrix from the mirror, phi = k g, delta = n k d with the discrete wavenumbers 2 asin(n k0 dx / 2) / dx): P = -(sin phi cos delta + cos phi sin delta / n), Q = cos phi cos delta - n sin phi sin delta; the gap carries travelling waves of amplitude A / sqrt(P^2 + Q^2), so the momentum balance gives F_x = eps0 A^2 Ly (1 - 1 / (P^2 + Q^2)) (eps0 A^2 Ly = 2 P_inc / c, the push on a perfect mirror). Near the quarter wave delta ~ pi / 2 the force swings from +0.56 to -1.25 eps0 A^2 Ly: positive (pushed toward the mirror) when the gap is anti-resonant, negative (pulled back toward the source by the strong cavity field) near g = m lambda / 2, zero near g = 145 nm and 630 nm.
Derived values tab: force_x (N/m, minus the anchor reaction) with its reference (no tolerance: it crosses 0), force_deviation = force_x / (eps0 A^2 Ly) minus the analytic value (reference 0, so an absolute error; the face form of the force carries O((n k0 dx)^2 / 2) of each interface term, which the cavity field enhances: expect a few 1e-3, tolerance 0.02) and net_flux = upstream power / P_inc (reference 0: a lossless closed cavity reflects everything, ~1e-6).
Sweep tab: force_x vs gap with the dashed analytic curve (sign change). Line profile tab (base gap 705 nm): E_gap = |E_z| between slab and mirror vs 2 A / sqrt(P^2 + Q^2) |sin(k (x_mirror - x))| (~2e-3). Field tab: em.ez_abs and solid.body_force_x.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.description: vacuum gap between the slab back face and the mirror plane (a cell edge to a cell centre: (m + 0.5) dx); swept

parameters.name: d_slab
parameters.description: slab thickness (26 cells, ~a quarter wave)

parameters.name: n_slab
parameters.description: slab refractive index (eps_r = n^2, lossless)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the FDFD solve

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 in 1/m

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: periodic y period (10 cells)

parameters.name: x_slab
parameters.description: slab front face (on a cell edge)

parameters.name: x_back
parameters.description: slab back face (on a cell edge)

parameters.name: x_mirror
parameters.description: E_z = 0 plane of the pec x_hi wall: the centre of the outermost window cell

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x (CPML outside x_lo, pec wall at x_hi)

parameters.name: x_source
parameters.description: line source x (cell centre), in vacuum

parameters.name: x_upstream
parameters.description: net-flux line x (cell centre) between the source and the slab

parameters.name: A_src
parameters.description: line source amplitude in V/m (radiated to each side)

parameters.name: P_inc
parameters.description: incident power in W/m the source sends toward +x: A^2 Ly / (2 eta0)

parameters.name: F_unit
parameters.description: force unit eps0 A^2 Ly = 2 P_inc / c in N/m (a perfect mirror alone)

parameters.name: k_gap
parameters.description: discrete vacuum wavenumber of the Yee grid in 1/m

parameters.name: k_slab
parameters.description: discrete wavenumber in the slab in 1/m

parameters.name: phi_gap
parameters.description: phase k g across the gap in rad

parameters.name: delta_slab
parameters.description: single-pass phase n k d of the slab in rad (~pi / 2)

parameters.name: P_tm
parameters.description: E at the slab front over the gap standing-wave amplitude (transfer matrix from the mirror)

parameters.name: Q_tm
parameters.description: dE/(k ds) at the slab front over the gap standing-wave amplitude

parameters.name: gain_gap
parameters.description: (incident amplitude / gap travelling amplitude)^2: 4/9..9/4 at the quarter wave

parameters.name: F_norm_ref
parameters.description: analytic force over eps0 A^2 Ly (momentum flux in front minus in the gap)

parameters.name: F_ref
parameters.description: analytic optical force on the slab along +x in N/m

parameters.name: E_gap_peak
parameters.description: peak |E_z| of the gap standing wave in V/m
